description: Benign, compliant call full of hesitations and backchannels, under heavy babble noise. Expect no nudges.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, this is Amit from Prithvi Health, this call is recorded. Is this a good time?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You asked about health insurance for yourself?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Uh, yes, yes. Just for me.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No... no, nothing like that. Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay. There's a thirty day initial waiting period, and pre-existing conditions are covered after twenty four months. For five lakh the premium is around six thousand four hundred rupees a year.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay... okay. Hmm. Let me see.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No problem, I'll email you the details.
